name: Games
purpose: Verify launch, seats, controls, reconnect, reload, persistence, performance and complete play journeys.

baseline_claims.need: Title, mode selection and start journey are usable.
Empty, human, AI and controller seats behave as declared.
Keyboard, gamepad, phone and AI seats receive their declared controls.
At least one complete start-play-outcome-continue journey succeeds.
Pause, inventory, mission and modal overlays restore camera and input.
Refresh, reconnect and save restore honestly or fail recoverably.
Frame, memory, idle and thermal behavior fit the declared body.
